landing.heroSubtitle: Resilire connects patients with registered doctors for secure, convenient online consultations.
landing.feature1Body: Create your patient or doctor account and set up your profile.
landing.feature2Body: Authentication and role-based access keep your account and data protected.
landing.feature3Body: Search doctors, book appointments and join your consultation through a Google Meet link generated for each booking.

about.title: About Resilire
about.paragraph1: Resilire is an online platform connecting patients with registered doctors for consultations. Patients can discover doctors, book consultations and join online consultations. Doctors can manage their professional profile, consultation availability and conduct online consultations.
about.paragraph2: This release covers account registration, authentication and role-based access for patients, doctors and administrators, doctor search and appointment booking, and Google Meet-based online consultations with appointment reminders.

help.title: Help & Support
help.intro: Need help getting started? Register as a patient or doctor from the homepage, then log in to access your account.
help.faq1: Patients can register, log in, manage their profile, search for doctors and book appointments.
help.faq2: Doctors can register, log in, manage their professional profile and set weekly consultation availability.
help.faq3: Each booked appointment includes an online consultation link; payments and full consultation history will be available in a future release.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.paragraph1: Resilire takes the security of your personal and medical information seriously. Passwords are stored using industry-standard hashing, and all API access requires authentication via secure tokens.
privacy.paragraph2: Access to patient and doctor information is restricted by role, so only authorized users can view or modify data appropriate to their account type.
